answer: When pronouncing "vieni a," ensure that the final vowel of "vieni" and the initial vowel of "a" are not merged into one sound, but rather smoothly connected within the same pitch. This technique helps maintain the natural flow of the phrase, especially when transitioning from the beginning of a sentence like "E vieni a dir" to "la tua canzon". If the melody requires connecting syllables with vowels, it is important to fully pronounce the word before the phrase ends, ensuring clarity and integrity of the text.
